rounds.text: IB Infotech Enterprises Ltd currently trades at a significant premium, with a P/E ratio of 49.1x [E1] and a P/B ratio of 15.38x [E2], both of which vastly exceed their respective sector benchmarks of 19.08x and 1.8x [E6, E7]. This valuation is increasingly detached from performance, as evidenced by the scanX signal engine indicating that price growth has outpaced profit growth by 165% [E52]. The company’s recent momentum is clearly faltering, with trailing twelve-month sales growth at -1% [E15] and profit growth at -2% [E18], further corroborated by a 34% year-over-year decline in sales [E64]. Consequently, the market is pricing in expectations that are no longer supported by the current trajectory of earnings, which are actively decelerating [E65]. Conceded: the company has demonstrated strong historical growth with a 34% three-year sales CAGR [E14] and an 84% five-year profit CAGR [E16], alongside an ROA of 18.67% that significantly outperforms the sector benchmark [E8]. However, these historical figures fail to justify the current valuation given the clear evidence of recent stagnation [E15, E18, E64].
